segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin report the cleanser cuts through oil and improves pore appearance, though one says it can be drying with frequent use and pairs it with extra moisturizer.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin get mixed results: some with dry or dry-leaning skin see smoother, brighter skin using it two to three times a week, while one reviewer with combination-oily skin found it too strong to recommend for dry skin.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin, several of whom describe a dry or redness-prone area alongside an oily T-zone, report it clears the oily areas without drying out the rest of the face.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin are split: several report breakouts, itching, or a reaction ranging from mild to severe, while a much larger number say it doesn't irritate or break out their sensitive skin at all.
segments.normal: The one reviewer who names normal skin says it worked well and wasn't aggravated by it even though her skin runs drier in winter.
segments.mature: Reviewers describing mature, aging skin, including a 71-year-old long-time user and one in her 50s, report smoother, softer skin and improved dullness.

concerns.aging: Reviewers who mention aging skin report smoother, softer skin and a more youthful look with regular use, including one long-time user in her 70s and another who says her skin now feels softer than in her 20s.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers, including many who say their skin runs dry, report the cleanser doesn't leave skin dry or tight; several others describe it as a little drying on first use, with overuse, in winter, or on oily skin needing extra moisturizer, and one says her face felt tight afterward despite the 'hydrating' label.
concerns.redness: Reviewers generally report no redness or irritation, including some who say it actually reduced their existing redness or calmed rosacea; one reviewer notes a brief redness right after rinsing, which she attributes to her own dermatographia rather than the product.
concerns.barrier: Most reviewers describe the cleanser as gentle enough not to strip the skin barrier; one reviewer who used it more often than recommended reports a few small bumps and suspects overuse compromised her barrier.
concerns.spots: A couple of reviewers report their post-acne dark marks faded somewhat faster with regular use of this cleanser.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers, including several who are acne-prone, report fewer breakouts, cleared clogged pores, or no new blemishes at all; a notable minority instead describe a mild to severe breakout, in one case bad enough to stop using the product.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily skin report the cleanser removes excess oil and improves pore appearance without stripping the skin, though one pairs it with extra moisturizer since frequent use left her skin drier.

extraits.titre: 2 stars for my skin reaction BUT a great product- try yourse
extraits.texte: I received this product in exchange for my honest review. I decided to try the Murad Hydration AHA/ BHA Exfoliating Cleanser for my skin to balance the exfoliation and hydration so it doesn't feel stripped or irritated. As I've gotten older my skin has been more sensitive to only certain things and it's normal oily but in the last couple of years it's a a weird combination type skin, so this appealed to me. When I first started using the cleanser I liked the texture of the fine exfoliation beads, the nice creamy base and a very light scent so it doesn't trigger one of my migraines. After rinsing my skin was soft and smooth, immediately a little red but that's only because of dermatograhia. I had a couple of pimples probably from adjusting to cleaning the skin with a new product, so I gave it more time. Then a couple of weeks later I broke out terrible, the picture I posted is not the worst of it. So the AHA/BHA cleanser has some ingredient that doesn't work with my skin. I find it unfortunate because I love Murad products and they are high quality, the container is even effective, it made it on a trip in luggage on a plane and back with not a hint of anything happening to it at all!! I rated it lower due to my experience with break outs because it made me unable to use any further. Otherwise as long as you know the product is safe for your skin, I would recommend.

extraits.titre: I absolutely love this so far!
extraits.texte: I have very sensitive skin but also aging as well. I met with a salesperson who helped me find an exfoliating product for aging skin. I've used it two weeks now and I can tell a huge difference in softness and small little bumps I had are going away!

I received this exfoliating cleanser in exchange for my honest review. I've been using this product for the past few weeks, 2-3 times a week. It has revived my dull flaky mature skin. My skin feels softer than it did when I was in my 20s and I'm now in my 50s. This product isn't only good for your facial skin but its also good for other parts of your body on external skin where you need exfoliation. I have tried other Murad products before but this is my first time ever trying this cleanser. I'm planning to buy the 16 ounce one when this one is finished. Thats how much I'm loving this product. Its very gentle on the skin which is a huge deal for me because I have rosacea and psoriasis and my skin doesn't always respond well to products like this. It's also scent free which is a plus. If you're on the hunt for a quality exfoliating product that can bring your skin back to life, your hunt is over. This is the product for you. You need this. Buy it!

I have oily skin and have been looking for a good quality face exfoliant for awhile. I've beeb using this product for a little over a month and I really like it. A little goes a long way and I wouldn't recommend using this with an exfoliant facial brush because it can probably be damaging to the skin barrier. I'd also only use this product twice a week as it can be drying so I have been using 2 moisturizers to keep my skin healthy. Overall, ive seen a major difference in my pores and general skin evenness!
